description_zh: 把电阻上的彩色条纹变成直观的数字。手动选择4、5或6环，逐环调整颜色，即时查看阻值、容差范围及6环电阻的温度系数。仿真电阻外观配合简洁界面，短按前进、长按后退，轻松对照手边电阻或练习色码识读。完全离线，随手就能用。封面为玩法示意图，界面图片为渲染预览。
description_en: Turn resistor color bands into clear, useful numbers. Choose a 4-, 5- or 6-band resistor, adjust each color, and instantly see its resistance, tolerance range and, for six bands, temperature coefficient. A realistic resistor illustration and uncluttered controls make it easy to compare with a resistor in hand or practice reading color codes. Tap to move forward, hold to go back, and explore entirely offline. The cover is an illustration; interface images are rendered previews.
